title: Q8
description:
“Not according to the law of a fleshly commandment, but according to the power of an endless life.”
Read: Psa 110:4, Num 20:28
a) Aaron died and his garments passed to his son. Psa 110:4 says “forever” (and Hebrews 7:17 quotes it as the witness). What does that contrast bring forward about the life that qualifies this Priest?
